## 3. The evidence that moved it

**`foundation-models` gains five cards and they are four different claims.**
Knowledge: [37438534](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37438534/) (*Nature*)
scores a general language model against clinical question sets and reports it as
encoding clinical knowledge, with *JAMA* covering the same class of result
[37467004](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37467004/). Design:
[37433327](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37433327/) (*Nature*) generates
protein backbones and functions that hold up experimentally, with a language
model writing functional sequences across diverse families
[36702895](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36702895/) (*Nat Biotechnol*, News &
Views [36702894](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36702894/)) and a universal
zinc-finger design model [36702896](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36702896/)
alongside it — three groups across two journals on the claim that these models
emit biology rather than predictions about biology, with mega-scale folding
stability data [37468638](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37468638/) underneath.
Deployment: [37541274](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37541274/) (*Lancet
Oncol*) compares AI-supported reading against standard double reading inside a
randomised screening programme, on a clinical safety endpoint. Transfer:
[37829001](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37829001/) (*Nat Mach Intell*) trains
pan-allelic networks on mass-spectrometry ligands and transfer-learns
immunogenicity, beating seven prior models on neoepitope precision — the gain
coming from transfer between a large task and a small one, which is the argument
for foundation models stated in its own terms and on a cancer problem. The status
line says `splitting`; these cards are not in tension, they are in different
layers.

**A microbiome intervention with a human readout, which is the thing this thread
has been short of.** [37414899](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37414899/) (*Nat
Med*) gives faecal microbiota transplantation with anti-PD-1 in a phase 1
melanoma trial. Beside it [37540734](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37540734/)
(*Sci Immunol*) has microbial energy metabolism sustaining a macrophage niche
inside isolated lymphoid tissue through purinergic signalling — microbial,
lymphoid-structural and small-molecule control inside one mechanism.
`neuro-immune-microbiome-axis` is the corpus's largest thread and its standing
weakness is that the microbial arm stays in mice; this month it is dosed in
people.

**Precancer as an object that can be found, read and acted on, in one month.**
[37537298](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37537298/) (*Nat Cancer*) uses
protein-level mutant p53 reporters to pull rare precancerous clones out of
histologically normal tissue and shows them to be druggable.
[37500728](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37500728/) (*Nat Genet*) reads
cell-free DNA as single-molecule genome-wide mutation profiles instead of a fixed
panel of known variants. And [37646678](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37646678/)
(*NEJM*) puts an anti-Epstein-Barr virus antibody test into mass screening for
nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

**Grade: gene-edited autologous cells treat a non-malignant disease in *NEJM*.**
[37646679](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37646679/) edits the HBG promoters in
patients' own haematopoietic cells for sickle cell disease, with the delivery-side
work done by lipid nanoparticles in the same month
[37294917](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37294917/) (*Blood*); *JAMA* separately
notes an FDA cell-therapy action in type 1 diabetes
[37436739](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37436739/). `cell-therapy` closes
+4 / −1, and the other three supports are in patients or primates rather than in
principle: a mesothelin-targeted TCR fusion construct returns a 20% response rate
and 77% disease control in refractory solid tumours
[37501016](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37501016/) (*Nat Med*); the TCRs
persisting after curative TIL therapy each recognise three unrelated tumour
antigens through one shared short motif
[37490916](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37490916/) (*Cell*); and NKG2D-directed
CAR T cells clear naturally occurring senescent cells in aged mice and non-human
primates [37585504](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37585504/) (*Sci Transl Med*),
which is the engineered-cell platform pointed at something that is not a tumour at
all. The single refutation is in section 4.

## 4. Refutations

### (a) Landing on a tracked thread

**The germline strain on `next-gen-checkpoints`, now stated twice by two groups.**
[37648262](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37648262/) (*J Immunother Cancer*)
reports a germline NKG2A variant that predicts immunotherapy outcome and reshapes
the NK repertoire. Read with last month's
[37264229](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37264229/) (*Nat Immunol*), where an
HLA class I signal peptide polymorphism sets how hard the same HLA-E axis presses
on effector cells, two journals one month apart have said that the magnitude of
this checkpoint's effect is a property of the host rather than of the target.
Everything the thread currently records is registry activity — whether a
nominated target reached a phase 1. This is a different and worse kind of strain,
because a target can be perfectly druggable and still deliver a different-sized
benefit to every patient, which would make both the unstratified preclinical
nomination and the unstratified trial the wrong instrument for measuring it. It
also cannot be seen from a trial registry at all, which is where this thread has
been doing its checking.

[37647386](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37647386/) (*Sci Transl Med*) —
activating TREM1 on myeloid cells promotes antitumour immunity. Inhibition is the
strategy this target was nominated for, and it is the wrong direction.

[37474835](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37474835/) (*Nat Cancer*, with its own
commentary [37474834](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37474834/)) — human solid
tumours carry γδ T cells split into opposing cytotoxic and wound-healing arms.
Neither depleting nor expanding the population has a defined sign.

[37553183](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37553183/) (*JITC*) — tumour
cell-intrinsic STING, and not host STING, drives local and systemic antitumour
immunity after cryoablation. That lands against `immunotherapy-resistance`, whose
claim is that the decisive machinery sits outside the tumour cell; the same
thread gains a supporting card in the same month from obesity redirecting host
monocyte development to enhance metastasis
[37166450](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37166450/) (*JEM*), and a second from
CCR7-negative cDC1 clustering with stem-like CD8 T cells in stromal niches
[37451271](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37451271/) (*Cancer Cell*).

Four more refutations land on the same thread, and three of them fail in one
place — the biomarker. Neither tumour mutational burden nor MSIsensor score
predicts checkpoint response in MSI metastatic colorectal cancer
[37269904](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37269904/) (*Ann Oncol*); no T-cell
population associates with response to Y90 radioembolisation followed by nivolumab
in hepatocellular carcinoma, and biomarkers established in prior immunotherapy
studies do not transfer [37586766](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37586766/)
(*JITC*); and across multiple cancers neither intratumoral TCR nor BCR repertoire
diversity is an independent prognostic biomarker of survival
[37604641](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37604641/) (*JITC*). The fourth is
mechanistic: PD-1 blockade increases the self-renewal of stem-like CD8 T cells as
fast as it accelerates their differentiation, leaving the progenitor pool intact
[37624909](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37624909/) (*Sci Immunol*). +2 / −5 on
one thread in four weeks is the honest state of it.

!!! note "Corrected 2026-09-04"
    This closed "+1 / −1 on one thread in four weeks is the honest state of it",
    counting one support and one refutation. The month is +2 / −5. The three
    biomarker failures and the PD-1 self-renewal result were all carded by the
    2026-09-04 abstract re-scan; none of them is visible in a title. The reading
    the sentence was defending — that a single STING result was the whole strain
    on this thread in August — was too small, and the strain is mostly about what
    can be measured before treatment rather than where the machinery sits.

[37474833](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37474833/) (*Nat Cancer*) — leukaemia
switches lineage after CD19-directed CAR T and blinatumomab, escaping by changing
what the cell is rather than what it displays.
[37607769](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37607769/) (*JITC*) — an
idiotype-neoantigen vaccine raises therapeutic T cells and the heavy-chain-loss
escapees cause disease. Two antigen-directed platforms, two antigen-independent
escapes, one month.

### (b) Method credibility

Seven cards. The sign is structural, as it is every month on this thread: it is a
ledger of things found unreliable and can report nothing but refutations, so read
what is being audited rather than the ratio.

[37563719](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37563719/) (*Genome Biol*) — a suspect
list of genomic regions that produce CUT&RUN signal regardless of the antibody.
Peak sets published before such a list existed carry artefacts nobody filtered,
because there was nothing to filter against.

[37429993](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37429993/) (*Nat Methods*) — a
significance test for single-cell clusters, which implies the populations
routinely reported from scRNA-seq are not established to be distinct. With
[37449901](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37449901/) (*Bioinformatics*) last
month, two independent groups in consecutive months have built tools to ask
whether the field's basic unit of analysis is real. That is the healthy reading
of `crisis` on this thread: not a collapse, an audit that has reached the bottom
layer.

[37386187](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37386187/) (*Nat Methods*) — running
single-coverage against multi-coverage metagenomic binning on the same samples
exposes contaminant contigs and chimeric bins the standard approach produces
silently. [37443337](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37443337/) (*Nat Methods*) —
sixteen circRNA callers on the same deeply sequenced cells return between 1,372
and 58,032 calls. Which tool was used determines what the paper reports. Three of
this month's method cards are in one journal.

[37459870](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37459870/) (*Lancet Oncol*) — a phase 2
immunotherapy trial in melanoma with CNS metastases is retracted and republished.
The numbers as originally read were wrong, in a trial already in the literature.

The last two are the *JITC* biomarker papers already described in (a):
[37586766](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37586766/) and
[37604641](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/37604641/). They are carded on both
threads because a biomarker that does not replicate is at once a fact about the
biology and a fact about the measurement.

!!! note "Corrected 2026-09-04"
    This section was headed "Three cards" and listed three. There are seven. The
